assets.name: hero-landscape
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original landscape hero illustration for the Vietnamese Huyền Học Các website, not a website mockup. Create an exquisite contemporary East Asian ink-and-watercolor landscape on warm ivory rice paper: layered distant limestone mountains fading into sage mist, a still jade lake, one delicate pine bough framing an upper corner, a small warm muted-brass sun and its very subtle reflection. Calm, contemplative, inviting, refined editorial illustration, tactile washi paper and translucent pigment, crisp forest-green foreground ink contrasting soft atmospheric depth. Color palette cream #f7f5ef, sage green, forest #294d3e, subdued brass #aa8b53. Composition landscape 3:2, the main lake and mountain forms centered, generous breathing space, organic paper margins softly fading to ivory. Rich enough to feel captivating but never busy. No people, no buildings, no lettering, no calligraphy, no logos, no watermark, no charts, no astrological symbols. This is a decorative artwork, not scientific imagery. Produce one standalone illustration.

assets.name: lotus-still-life
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original decorative editorial watercolor for a refined Vietnamese personal insight and home harmony website. One standalone landscape 3:2 image: an elegant small celadon ceramic vase holding one cream lotus blossom and a gracefully curving sage-green lotus leaf, placed beside a smooth warm river stone on a light oak surface. A very soft out-of-focus bamboo shadow falls behind, with plentiful warm ivory #fffefa rice-paper negative space around the objects and fading paper edges. Contemporary East Asian ink and watercolor, delicate handmade textures, restrained forest-green ink contours, luminous cream petals, muted brass accent, beautiful natural balanced composition. Serene and visually engaging, not photorealistic and not a product advertisement. Centered still life readable at small size. No text, no lettering, no people, no figures, no incense smoke, no ritual promises, no logos or watermark, no interface.
